entries.2c39211fbd4b6f0e: A substance such as silicon with properties between those of a conductor, which conducts electricity well, and an insulator, which hardly conducts it. Transistors and integrated circuits made from it are also called "semiconductors," and they handle the storage of information and calculation inside electronic devices.
